TYPES = %w[AND OR NAND NOR XOR XNOR NOT BUF MUX2 DFF].freeze
COUNTS = %w[
  BUILD:1
  RESET:0
  SET:3
  APPLY:2
  PULSE:3
  CLOCK:4
  RUN:1
  WATCH:1
  UNWATCH:1
  SHOW:0
  CHECK:2
  PROBE:1
  WAVE:2
  HISTORY:1
  ACTIVITY:1
  STATUS:0
  MODULES:0
  NETLIST:1
  HIERARCHY:1
  STATS:1
  TRUTHTABLE:1
  EQUIV:2
  FAULTS:1
  CRITICAL:1
  PERIOD:1
]
  .to_h { |x|
    k, v = x.split(":")
    [k, v.to_i]
  }
SIM = %w[RESET SET APPLY PULSE CLOCK RUN WATCH UNWATCH SHOW CHECK PROBE WAVE HISTORY ACTIVITY STATUS].freeze
Gate = Struct.new(:name, :kind, :inputs, :output, :delay)
Instance = Struct.new(:name, :mod, :connections)
Mod = Struct.new(:name, :inputs, :outputs, :body)
def name?(s) = /\A[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,15}\z/.match?(s)
def number?(s) = /\A(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,8})\z/.match?(s)
def number(s, positive = false)
  raise "bad number #{s}" unless number?(s) && (!positive || s != "0")
  s.to_i
end

def value(s)
  raise "bad value #{s}" unless %w[0 1 X].include?(s)
  s
end

def bits(r, n) = n.times.map { |i| ((r >> (n - 1 - i)) & 1).to_s }.join
def logic(kind, a)
  y = case kind
  when "AND", "NAND"
    a.include?("0") ? "0" : a.include?("X") ? "X" : "1"
  when "OR", "NOR"
    a.include?("1") ? "1" : a.include?("X") ? "X" : "0"
  when "XOR", "XNOR"
    a.include?("X") ? "X" : (a.count("1") % 2).to_s
  when "MUX2"
    a[0] == "X" ? (a[1] == a[2] ? a[1] : "X") : a[a[0] == "0" ? 1 : 2]
  else
    a[0]
  end

  %w[NAND NOR XNOR NOT].include?(kind) ? {"0" => "1", "1" => "0", "X" => "X"}[y] : y
end

class Circuit
  attr_reader :name, :inputs, :outputs, :gates, :signals, :driver, :readers, :flops, :order
  def initialize(mod)
    @name, @inputs, @outputs = mod.name, mod.inputs, mod.outputs
    @gates = []
    expand(mod, "", {})
    @signals = @inputs + @gates.map(&:output)
    @driver = @gates.to_h { |g| [g.output, g] }
    @readers = @signals.to_h { |s| [s, []] }
    @gates.each { |g| g.inputs.uniq.each { |s| @readers[s] << g } }
    @flops = @gates.select { |g| g.kind == "DFF" }
    waiting = {}
    ready = []
    @gates.each do |g|
      next if g.kind == "DFF"
      waiting[g.output] = g.inputs.uniq.count { |s| @driver.key?(s) && @driver[s].kind != "DFF" }
      ready << g if waiting[g.output] == 0
    end

    @order = []
    until ready.empty?
      g = ready.pop
      @order << g
      @readers[g.output].each do |r|
        next if r.kind == "DFF"
        waiting[r.output] -= 1
        ready << r if waiting[r.output] == 0
      end
    end

    @order = nil if @order.size != waiting.size
  end

  def expand(mod, prefix, ports)
    actual = -> (s) { ports.fetch(s, prefix + s) }
    mod.body.each do |x|
      if x.is_a?(Gate)
        @gates << Gate.new(prefix + x.name, x.kind, x.inputs.map(&actual), actual.call(x.output), x.delay)
      else
        expand(x.mod, prefix + x.name + ".", x.connections.to_h { |p, s| [p, actual.call(s)] })
      end
    end
  end

  def combinational
    raise "#{@name} is not combinational" unless @flops.empty?
    raise "#{@name} has a combinational loop" unless @order
    raise "too many inputs #{@inputs.size}" if @inputs.size > 8
    self
  end

  def evaluate(b, stuck = nil, v = nil)
    values = @inputs.zip(b.chars).to_h
    values[stuck] = v if values.key?(stuck)
    @order.each { |g| values[g.output] = g.output == stuck ? v : logic(g.kind, g.inputs.map { |s| values[s] }) }
    @outputs.map { |s| values[s] }.join
  end

  def arrivals(period)
    late = period ? @flops.to_h { |g| [g.output, g.delay] } : @inputs.to_h { |s| [s, 0] }
    early = late.dup
    prev = {}
    @order.each do |g|
      a = g.inputs.select { |s| late.key?(s) }
      next if a.empty?
      best = a.max_by { |s| late[s] }
      late[g.output] = late[best] + g.delay
      early[g.output] = a.map { |s| early[s] }.min + g.delay
      prev[g.output] = best
    end

    [late, early, prev]
  end
end

class Simulation
  attr_accessor :watch, :values, :time, :queue, :history, :processed, :halted
  attr_reader :circuit
  def initialize(c)
    @circuit = c
    @watch = []
    reset
  end

  def reset
    @values = @circuit.signals.to_h { |s| [s, "X"] }
    @time = 0
    @queue = []
    @sequence = 0
    @history = @circuit.signals.to_h { |s| [s, []] }
    @processed = 0
    @halted = false
  end

  def schedule(t, s, v)
    e = [t, @sequence, s, v]
    @sequence += 1
    i = @queue.size
    @queue << e
    while i > 0
      p = (i - 1) / 2
      break if (@queue[p][0, 2] <=> e[0, 2]) <= 0
      @queue[i] = @queue[p]
      i = p
    end

    @queue[i] = e
  end

  def pop
    result = @queue[0]
    last = @queue.pop
    unless @queue.empty?
      i = 0
      while 2 * i + 1 < @queue.size
        j = 2 * i + 1
        j += 1 if j + 1 < @queue.size && (@queue[j + 1][0, 2] <=> @queue[j][0, 2]) < 0
        break if (last[0, 2] <=> @queue[j][0, 2]) <= 0
        @queue[i] = @queue[j]
        i = j
      end

      @queue[i] = last
    end

    result
  end

  def run(ending)
    total = 0
    glitches = 0
    while !@queue.empty? && @queue[0][0] < ending
      t = @queue[0][0]
      start = @values.dup
      changed = []
      count = 0
      while !@queue.empty? && @queue[0][0] == t
        if count == 1000
          puts("halted: oscillation at time #{t}")
          @queue = []
          @time = t
          @halted = true
          return
        end

        _, _, s, v = pop
        count += 1
        @processed += 1
        old = @values[s]
        next if old == v
        @values[s] = v
        changed << s
        @circuit.readers[s].each do |g|
          if g.kind != "DFF"
            schedule(t + g.delay, g.output, logic(g.kind, g.inputs.map { |x| @values[x] }))
          elsif s == g.inputs[0] && old == "0" && v == "1"
            schedule(t + g.delay, g.output, @values[g.inputs[1]])
          end
        end
      end

      total += count
      changed.uniq.each { |s| @values[s] == start[s] ? glitches += 1 : @history[s] << [t, @values[s]] }
      @watch.each { |s| puts("#{t} #{s} #{@values[s]}") if @values[s] != start[s] }
    end

    @time = ending
    puts("run #{ending} events #{total} glitches #{glitches} pending #{@queue.size}")
  end

  def describe(a) = a.map { |s| "#{s}=#{@values[s]}" }
end

class Simulator
  def initialize = (
    @modules = {}
    @sim = nil
  )
  def lookup(s) = @modules.fetch(s) { raise "unknown module #{s}" }
  def signal(s) = (raise "unknown signal #{s}" unless @sim.values.key?(s))
  def input(s) = (raise "not an input #{s}" unless @sim.circuit.inputs.include?(s))
  def time(w)
    t = number(w)
    raise "time #{t} is in the past" if t < @sim.time
    t
  end

  def define(header_no, lines)
    line_no = header_no
    begin
      w = lines[0].split(" ")
      raise "bad module header" unless w.size >= 5 && w[2] == "IN" && w[3..].count("OUT") == 1 && w[-1] != "OUT"
      name = w[1]
      raise "bad module name #{name}" unless /\A[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,15}\z/.match?(name)
      raise "duplicate module #{name}" if @modules.key?(name)
      split = w[3..].index("OUT") + 3
      ins = w[3...split]
      outs = w[(split + 1)..]
      seen = []
      (ins + outs).each { |p|
        raise "bad name #{p}" unless name?(p)
        raise "duplicate port #{p}" if seen.include?(p)
        seen << p
      }
      driven = ins.dup
      used = []
      body = []
      reads = []
      lines.drop(1).each_with_index do |line, i|
        line_no = header_no + i + 1
        a = line.split(" ")
        kind = a[0]
        n = a[1]
        if TYPES.include?(kind)
          raise "bad gate syntax" unless a.size >= 5 && a[-3] == "->" && a.count("->") == 1
          raise "bad name #{n}" unless name?(n)
          inputs = a[2...-3]
          output = a[-2]
          delay = a[-1]
          low = %w[NOT BUF].include?(kind) ? 1 : kind == "MUX2" ? 3 : 2
          high = TYPES.index(kind) < 6 ? 8 : low
          raise "bad input count #{inputs.size} for #{kind}" unless (low..high).cover?(inputs.size)
          (inputs + [output]).each { |s| raise "bad name #{s}" unless name?(s) }
          raise "bad delay #{delay}" unless number?(delay) && delay.to_i <= 1000
          raise "duplicate name #{n}" if used.include?(n)
          raise "multiple drivers for #{output}" if driven.include?(output)
          driven << output
          used << n
          body << Gate.new(n, kind, inputs, output, delay.to_i)
          inputs.each { |s| reads << [line_no, s] }
        elsif kind == "INST"
          raise "bad instance syntax" if a.size < 3
          raise "bad name #{n}" unless name?(n)
          m = lookup(a[2])
          connections = {}
          a.drop(3).each do |word|
            p = word.split("=", -1)
            raise "bad connection #{word}" unless p.size == 2 && !p[0].empty? && !p[1].empty?
            port, s = p
            raise "unknown port #{port}" unless (m.inputs + m.outputs).include?(port)
            raise "duplicate connection #{port}" if connections.key?(port)
            raise "bad name #{s}" unless name?(s)
            connections[port] = s
          end

          m.inputs.each { |p| raise "unconnected input #{p}" unless connections.key?(p) }
          raise "duplicate name #{n}" if used.include?(n)
          connections.each { |p, s|
            next unless m.outputs.include?(p)
            raise "multiple drivers for #{s}" if driven.include?(s)
            driven << s
          }
          used << n
          body << Instance.new(n, m, connections)
          connections.each { |p, s| reads << [line_no, s] if m.inputs.include?(p) }
        else
          raise "unknown statement #{kind}"
        end
      end

      outs.each { |s| reads << [header_no, s] }
      reads.each { |n, s|
        next if driven.include?(s)
        line_no = n
        raise "undriven signal #{s}"
      }
      @modules[name] = Mod.new(name, ins, outs, body)
      gates = body.count { |x| x.is_a?(Gate) }
      puts("defined #{name} inputs #{ins.size} outputs #{outs.size} gates #{gates} instances #{body.size - gates}")
    rescue RuntimeError => e
      puts("error: line #{line_no}: #{e.message}")
    end
  end

  def hierarchy(m, depth)
    m.body.each { |x|
      next unless x.is_a?(Instance)
      puts("  " * depth + "#{x.name} #{x.mod.name}")
      hierarchy(x.mod, depth + 1)
    }
  end

  def execute(line_no, w)
    cmd = w[0]
    a = w.drop(1)
    raise "unknown command #{cmd}" unless COUNTS.key?(cmd)
    unless a.size >= COUNTS[cmd] && (%w[WATCH UNWATCH SHOW].include?(cmd) || a.size == COUNTS[cmd])
      raise "wrong argument count"
    end

    raise "no circuit" if SIM.include?(cmd) && !@sim
    s = @sim
    raise "simulation halted" if %w[SET APPLY PULSE CLOCK RUN].include?(cmd) && s.halted
    case cmd
    when "MODULES"
      puts("modules #{@modules.size}")
      @modules.each_value { |m|
        puts("#{m.name} inputs #{m.inputs.size} outputs #{m.outputs.size} gates #{Circuit.new(m).gates.size}")
      }
    when "BUILD", "NETLIST", "HIERARCHY", "STATS", "TRUTHTABLE", "EQUIV", "FAULTS", "CRITICAL", "PERIOD"
      m = lookup(a[0])
      m2 = lookup(a[1]) if cmd == "EQUIV"
      c = Circuit.new(m)
      case cmd
      when "BUILD"
        @sim = Simulation.new(c)
        puts("built #{c.name} signals #{c.signals.size} gates #{c.gates.size}")
      when "NETLIST"
        puts("netlist #{c.name} gates #{c.gates.size} signals #{c.signals.size}")
        c.gates.each { |g| puts("#{g.name} #{g.kind} #{g.inputs.join(" ")} -> #{g.output} #{g.delay}") }
      when "HIERARCHY"
        puts(m.name)
        hierarchy(m, 1)
      when "STATS"
        levels = (c.inputs + c.flops.map(&:output)).to_h { |x| [x, 0] }
        c.order&.each { |g| levels[g.output] = g.inputs.map { |x| levels[x] }.max + 1 }
        puts(
          "stats #{c.name} gates #{c.gates.size} signals #{c.signals.size} depth #{c.order ? levels.values.max : "-"}"
        )
        puts(
          (["types"] +
            TYPES.flat_map { |t|
              n = c.gates.count { |g| g.kind == t }
              n == 0 ? [] : [t, n]
            })
            .join(" ")
        )
        best = c.signals.max_by { |x| c.readers[x].size }
        puts("max fanout #{best} #{c.readers[best].size}")
      when "CRITICAL", "PERIOD"
        period = cmd == "PERIOD"
        raise "#{c.name} has no flip-flops" if period && c.flops.empty?
        raise "#{c.name} has a combinational loop" unless c.order
        late, early, prev = c.arrivals(period)
        ends = period ? c.flops.map { |g| g.inputs[1] } : c.outputs
        ends.each { |x| puts(late.key?(x) ? "#{x} min #{early[x]} max #{late[x]}" : "#{x} unreachable") } unless period
        reached = ends.select { |x| late.key?(x) }
        heading = period ? "flip-flops #{c.flops.size} period" : "critical"
        if reached.empty?
          puts(heading + " none")
        else
          best = reached.max_by { |x| late[x] }
          path = [best]
          path << prev[path[-1]] while prev.key?(path[-1])
          puts("#{heading} #{late[best]}: #{path.reverse.join(" -> ")}")
        end
      else
        c.combinational
        rows = (0...2 ** c.inputs.size).map { |r| bits(r, c.inputs.size) }
        expected = rows.map { |b| c.evaluate(b) }
        if cmd == "TRUTHTABLE"
          puts((c.inputs + ["|"] + c.outputs).join(" "))
          rows.each_with_index { |b, r| puts((b.chars + ["|"] + expected[r].chars).join(" ")) }
        elsif cmd == "EQUIV"
          d = Circuit.new(m2).combinational
          raise "port mismatch" unless c.inputs.size == d.inputs.size && c.outputs.size == d.outputs.size
          r = rows.each_index.find { |i| expected[i] != d.evaluate(rows[i]) }
          puts(r ? "not equivalent at #{rows[r]}: #{expected[r]} vs #{d.evaluate(rows[r])}" : "equivalent")
        else
          undetected = []
          tests = []
          c.signals.each { |x|
            %w[0 1].each { |v|
              r = rows.each_index.find { |i| c.evaluate(rows[i], x, v) != expected[i] }
              r ? tests << r : undetected << "#{x}/#{v}"
            }
          }
          total = 2 * c.signals.size
          puts("faults #{total} detected #{total - undetected.size}")
          undetected.each { |f| puts("undetected " + f) }
          puts((["tests"] + tests.uniq.sort.map { |r| rows[r] }).join(" "))
        end
      end

    when "RESET"
      s.reset
      puts("reset")
    when "SET"
      t = time(a[0])
      input(a[1])
      value(a[2])
      s.schedule(t, a[1], a[2])
      puts("set #{a[1]} #{a[2]} at #{t}")
    when "APPLY"
      t = time(a[0])
      b = a[1]
      raise "bad vector #{b}" unless b.size == s.circuit.inputs.size && /\A[01X]*\z/.match?(b)
      s.circuit.inputs.each_with_index { |x, i| s.schedule(t, x, b[i]) }
      puts("apply #{b} at #{t}")
    when "PULSE", "CLOCK"
      input(a[0])
      t = time(a[1])
      width = number(a[2], true)
      if cmd == "PULSE"
        s.schedule(t, a[0], "1")
        s.schedule(t + width, a[0], "0")
        puts("pulse #{a[0]} #{t} #{t + width}")
      else
        count = number(a[3], true)
        count.times { |i| s.schedule(t + i * width, a[0], (i % 2).to_s) }
        puts("clock #{a[0]} events #{count} last #{t + (count - 1) * width}")
      end

    when "RUN"
      t = number(a[0])
      raise "time #{t} is not after #{s.time}" if t <= s.time
      s.run(t)
    when "WATCH", "UNWATCH"
      seen = []
      a.each { |x|
        signal(x)
        bad = cmd == "WATCH" ? s.watch.include?(x) || seen.include?(x) : !s.watch.include?(x) || seen.include?(x)
        raise "#{cmd == "WATCH" ? "already watched" : "not watched"} #{x}" if bad
        seen << x
      }
      s.watch = cmd == "WATCH" ? s.watch + a : s.watch - a
      puts("watching " + (s.watch.empty? ? "nothing" : s.watch.join(" ")))
    when "SHOW"
      a.each { |x| signal(x) }
      puts((a.empty? ? s.describe(s.circuit.inputs) + ["|"] + s.describe(s.circuit.outputs) : s.describe(a)).join(" "))
    when "CHECK"
      signal(a[0])
      value(a[1])
      puts("check #{a[0]}=#{a[1]} " + (s.values[a[0]] == a[1] ? "ok" : "failed (#{s.values[a[0]]})"))
    when "PROBE"
      x = a[0]
      signal(x)
      g = s.circuit.driver[x]
      puts(
        "#{x}=#{s.values[x]} driven by " +
          (g ? "#{g.name} #{g.kind} #{s.describe(g.inputs).join(" ")} delay #{g.delay}" : "input")
      )
      r = s.circuit.readers[x]
      puts((["fanout", r.size] + r.map(&:name)).join(" "))
    when "WAVE"
      first = number(a[0])
      last = number(a[1])
      raise "bad range #{first} #{last}" unless first < last && last <= s.time
      raise "nothing watched" if s.watch.empty?
      s.watch.each do |x|
        h = s.history[x]
        i = 0
        v = "X"
        wave = (first...last)
          .map { |t|
            while i < h.size && h[i][0] <= t
              v = h[i][1]
              i += 1
            end

            v
          }
          .join
        puts(x + " " + wave)
      end

    when "HISTORY"
      x = a[0]
      signal(x)
      h = s.history[x]
      puts((["history", x, "changes", h.size] + h.map { |t, v| "#{t}:#{v}" }).join(" "))
    when "ACTIVITY"
      k = number(a[0], true)
      s.circuit.signals.sort_by { |x| [-s.history[x].size, x] }.first(k).each { |x| puts("#{x} #{s.history[x].size}") }
    when "STATUS"
      puts(
        "circuit #{s.circuit.name} time #{s.time} pending #{s.queue.size} events #{s.processed} halted #{s.halted ? "yes" : "no"}"
      )
      puts("values 0:#{s.values.values.count("0")} 1:#{s.values.values.count("1")} X:#{s.values.values.count("X")}")
    end

  rescue RuntimeError => e
    puts("error: line #{line_no}: #{e.message}")
  end
end

lines = STDIN.each_line.map(&:chomp)
simulator = Simulator.new
i = 0
while i < lines.size && lines[i] != "END"
  if lines[i].split(" ")[0] == "MODULE"
    last = i + 1
    last += 1 until lines[last] == "ENDMODULE"
    simulator.define(i + 1, lines[i...last])
    i = last + 1
  else
    simulator.execute(i + 1, lines[i].split(" "))
    i += 1
  end
end
